# @hiro/niru-chat-kit: full reference

Two entry points. `@hiro/niru-chat-kit` is the core: no UI library, no URL, no `@mui`. `@hiro/niru-chat-kit/mui` is the MUI skin and imports the core. Both are ESM with type declarations. Every prop below is optional unless it is listed without a `?`.

Install: `pnpm add github:HiroLabz/niru-chat-kit#<tag-or-commit>`. Peer dependencies: react and react-dom 19, @mui/material 9, @mui/icons-material, @emotion/react, @emotion/styled, react-markdown, remark-gfm, marked. Optional, loaded on demand: shiki (code highlighting), remark-math, rehype-katex, katex (maths).

Rules that hold everywhere: colours come from tokens (`--nck-*` CSS variables and `useChatKitStyles`); the heavy optional libraries are dynamic imports; compound parts throw when used outside their root; slot props (`slotProps.root`, ...) pass extra props to inner elements.

## Minimal chat

```tsx
import { useChatStream, type ChatTransport } from "@hiro/niru-chat-kit";
import { ChatKitProvider, FullChat } from "@hiro/niru-chat-kit/mui";

declare const transport: ChatTransport;

export function Chat() {
  const stream = useChatStream(transport);
  return (
    <ChatKitProvider>
      <FullChat stream={stream} agent={{ name: "Niru", initial: "N" }} />
    </ChatKitProvider>
  );
}
```

# Core entry: `@hiro/niru-chat-kit`

## Transport and types

- `ChatTransport<TParams>`: the only door to a backend. `send(turn, signal)` resolves with an async iterable of stream frames; `stop(runId)`; optional `regenerate`, `resume(turn, signal)` and `branches`. Example: `const transport: ChatTransport = { send: async (turn, signal) => parseSseStream((await fetch("/chat", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(turn), signal })).body!), stop: async () => true };`
- `ChatTurn`: one turn handed to `send` (`message`, `conversationId`, `startNewConversation`, `regenerate?`, `params?`).
- `ChatResumeTurn`: the answer to a paused run (`conversationId`, `threadId`, `interruptKind`, `answer`, `values?`).
- `ChatBranches`: `load`, `switchTo` and optional `fork` and `canEdit`; the server owns the conversation tree.
- `ChatForkResult`: what a fork returns (`conversationId`, `messages`, `message`).
- `ForkKind`: `"regenerate" | "edit"`.
- `ChatTransportError`: a failed transport call; `message` is shown beside Retry, with `code` and `status`.
- `ChatMessage`: one turn (`id`, `role`, `text`, `pending?`, `citations?`, `steps?`, `parts?`, `serverId?`, `siblingIds?`, `files?` ...).
- `ChatRole`: `"user" | "assistant" | "system"`.
- `ChatTurnActions`: the per-turn controls a transcript offers: `disabled`, `onRegenerate`, `onEdit`, `canEdit`, `onSwitchBranch`, `onCopy`, `renderCopy`, `onFeedback`, `renderExtraActions`, `onDelete(message)`, `onSave(message)`, `isSaved(message)` (a bookmark toggle after Copy on assistant replies). A control shows only when its handler is given. Example: `const actions: ChatTurnActions = { disabled: false, onDelete: (m) => remove(m.serverId) };`
- `FeedbackRating`: `"up" | "down"`.
- `MessageStatus`: `"completed" | "stopped"`.
- `Citation`, `CitationCheck`: a source a reply cites, and the grounding check on it.
- `Interrupt`: a pause waiting on the end user (`kind`, `question`, `options?`).
- `InvokeResponse`, `StreamResultData`, `MessageOut`: the terminal result of a run and a stored message row.
- `AgentStreamEvent`: the union of stream frames: `status`, `token`, `tool`, `thinking`, `reasoning`, `suggestions`, `needs_input`, `result`, `error`, `done`.
- `AgentStreamStatus`: `"idle" | "connecting" | "streaming" | "needs_input" | "done" | "error"`.
- `StatusEventData`, `TokenEventData`, `ReasoningEventData`, `SuggestionsEventData`, `NeedsInputEventData`, `ErrorEventData`, `ToolFrameData`, `ThinkingFrameData`: the payload of each frame.
- `RunIds`, `RunShaping`, `RunShapingFields`, `ShapingStatus`: ids of the running conversation, and the response-schema outcome of a run.
- `ChatReplay`, `BranchReplay`: what a retry replays, and a branch's replay data.
- `GeneratedFileRef`, `GeneratedFileFormat`: a file a turn made.
- `TurnPart`, `SplitParts`, `WorkingStep`, `StepDetails`, `ToolKind`: a turn in stream order, its tool and thought rows, and an icon family.

## Streaming hooks

- `useChatStream(transport, { params, initialMessages, initialConversationId, initialThreadId, branching })`: a streamed chat. Returns `messages`, `status`, `error`, `interrupt`, `followUps`, `turnActions`, `send`, `stop`, `retry`, `resume` and more. Example: `const { messages, send, stop } = useChatStream(transport);`
- `UseChatStreamOptions`: the options above.
- `useConversationBranches`, `UseConversationBranchesOptions`, `annotateFromMessages`: regenerate, edit and version switching against `ChatBranches`.
- `useFollowUps()`: the AI follow-ups for the newest settled reply.
- `useRunIds()`: the conversation, thread and principal ids as state and refs.
- `useStreamFailure()`: why the last turn failed (message, code, status).
- `useStreamTranscript(initialMessages)`: the transcript and the edits a run makes to it.
- `useStepFrames`: keeps a streamed message's steps in sync with `tool` and `thinking` frames.
- `useSuggestionFill(setDraft)`: wires suggestion pills to the box (fills, never sends); returns `inputRef` and `fill`.
- `newId()`: a fresh local message id.
- `newestAssistantId(messages)`: the newest agent turn's id.

## Stream parsing and reducers

- `parseSseStream(body, signal?, idleTimeoutMs?)`: async generator of typed frames from an SSE body; throws `SseStallError` when the body goes quiet.
- `SseStallError`, `SSE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS`, `SSE_STALL_MESSAGE`: the stall error, its 60 s limit and the copy shown.
- `SseFrame`: one raw SSE frame.
- `shapingFromResult`, `readRunShaping`: read the response-schema outcome from a result.
- `applyToolFrame`, `applyThinkingFrame`, `settleRunningSteps`: fold frames into a step list and settle running steps.
- `applyToolFrameToParts`, `applyThinkingFrameToParts`, `appendTokenPart`, `appendReasoningPart`, `settleRunningParts`: the same on a turn's parts, in stream order.
- `splitTurnParts(parts, pending)`: answer text versus timeline.
- `hasVisibleActivity`, `isInternalStep`, `isListedStep`, `INTERNAL_TOOL_NAMES`, `toolKindOf`, `summarizeTitles`, `formatTurnDuration`: which steps show, and how they are named and timed.
- `answerSource(message)`: the markdown source of a settled reply.
- `resultFields(data, streamedText)`: what a terminal `result` frame says about the settled bubble.
- `stepTitle`, `humanizeToolName`, `formatStepDuration`: step labels and durations.

## History

- `toChatMessages(rows)`: a stored conversation as chat turns.
- `annotateFromHistory(local, rows)`: attaches server ids and branch positions to a live transcript.
- `filesFromRow`, `filesOfTurn`, `formatFileSize`: generated files as chip data.
- `readCitationCheck(value)`: narrows the loose `citation_check` object.
- `isStructuredEcho`: detects a reply that only echoes structured output.
- `conversationAgeGroup(at, now?)`: `"today" | "yesterday" | "previous7" | "previous30" | "older"` by calendar day; no date is older. Example: `conversationAgeGroup(row.at, new Date())`.
- `groupConversationsByAge(items, now?)`: the non-empty groups in age order, keeping item order. Example: `groupConversationsByAge(rows).map((g) => g.group)`.
- `filterConversations(items, query)`: case-insensitive match on `title` and `preview`.
- `CONVERSATION_AGE_GROUPS`, `DEFAULT_AGE_GROUP_LABELS`, `ConversationAgeGroup`, `ConversationGroup`, `ConversationTime`: the group order, default labels and types.

## Voice input

- `useSpeechInput({ lang?, onFinal?, onInterim? })`: the browser's own speech recognition (`SpeechRecognition` or `webkitSpeechRecognition`), feature-detected after mount so it is safe on the server. Returns `{ supported, listening, interim, error, start, stop }`; stops on unmount. Example: `const { supported, listening, start, stop } = useSpeechInput({ lang: "en-PH", onFinal: (t) => setDraft((d) => d + " " + t) });`
- `UseSpeechInputOptions`, `UseSpeechInputResult`, `SpeechRecognitionLike`: its types.
- Recording voice input: `useSpeechInput({ transcribe, microphoneId?, maxDurationMs?, disabledReason?, ... })` records with `MediaRecorder` instead of using browser recognition, and `onFinal` gets the text `transcribe` resolves with. `transcribe(audio: Blob, info: { mime, durationMs }): Promise<string>` is the app's (`TranscribeAudio`); reject with an Error whose message is plain words. It asks for the microphone with `echoCancellation`, `noiseSuppression`, `autoGainControl`, mono and the chosen device; MIME type in order `audio/webm;codecs=opus`, `audio/webm`, `audio/mp4`, `audio/ogg;codecs=opus` (`RECORDING_MIME_TYPES`); stops by itself at `maxDurationMs` (default 120000, `DEFAULT_MAX_RECORDING_MS`). The result gains `recorded` (`UseRecordedSpeechResult`: `supported`, `state` idle, asking, recording, transcribing or failed (`RecordedSpeechState`), `elapsedMs`, `level` 0 to 1, `failure` (`SpeechFailure`: `permission-denied`, `no-microphone`, `microphone-busy`, `recording-failed`, `transcription-failed`, `nothing-heard`), `detail` (the app's message), `start`, `stop`, `cancel`) and `disabledReason`. An empty text is `nothing-heard` and adds nothing. Every track is stopped on stop, cancel, failure and unmount; no audio is kept. `useRecordedSpeech` is the recorder alone. Without `transcribe` nothing changes. Example: `const { recorded, start, stop } = useSpeechInput({ transcribe: async (blob) => (await sendToStt(blob)).text, onFinal: (t) => setDraft((d) => d + " " + t) });`
- `speechErrorMessage(code)`: a short sentence for the recorder failures above, `not-allowed`, `no-speech`, `audio-capture`, `network` and others; empty for no error.

## Voice calls

- `VoiceSession`: the contract a transport implements. `getSnapshot()`, `subscribe(listener)`, `levels`, `setMuted(muted)`, `setCaptions(on)`, `setCamera(on)` and `setScreenShare(on)` (promises that never reject), `hold()`, `resume()`, `startAudio()`, `end()`, `retry()`. An implementation must switch the camera and screen share off when the call is held, ended or failed.
- `VoiceSnapshot`: `phase`, `step`, `muted`, optional `activity` (a short sentence the app supplies, such as "Searching the web"; shown under the status while `thinking` or `speaking`), `captions`, `transcript`, `capabilities`, `problem`, `cameraOn`, `screenOn`, `localVideo`, `localScreen`, `remoteVideo`, `deviceError`, `startedAt`, `endedAt`. Types: `VoicePhase` (`connecting`, `listening`, `thinking`, `speaking`, `held`, `ended`, `failed`), `VoiceJoinStep` (`joining`, `connecting`, `microphone`, `audio`, `ready`), `VoiceProblem` (`microphone-blocked`, `audio-blocked`, `connection-lost`), `VoiceCapabilities` (`mute`, `captions`, `camera`, `screenShare`, `hold`), `VoiceTranscriptSegment`, `VoiceDeviceError`, `VoiceLevels`, `VoiceLevelSnapshot`.
- `useVoiceSession(session)`: the snapshot on `useSyncExternalStore`; also asks the session to switch the camera and screen share off whenever the call is held, ended or failed. Example: `const call = useVoiceSession(session); call.phase`.
- `createFakeVoiceSession(options?)`: a scriptable session for tests and demos. Options `phase`, `step`, `activity`, `capabilities`, `captions`, `muted`, `transcript`, `problem`, `media`, `now`, `joinMs`. `session.script` has `setPhase`, `setStep`, `setActivity`, `setLevels`, `say`, `settle`, `setCapabilities`, `fail`, `clearProblem`, `setRemoteVideo`, `failDevices`, `simulateLevels`, `play(steps)` and `stop()`; `session.calls` records the methods called. Types `FakeVoiceSession`, `FakeVoiceSessionOptions`, `FakeVoiceScript`, `FakeScriptStep`; `wobbleLevel(ms, seed?)` is a plausible voice level. Example: `const s = createFakeVoiceSession({ capabilities: { camera: true } }); s.script.say("agent", "Hello")`.
- `useLocalMedia(options?)`: the visitor's own camera and screen share as local preview streams (`getUserMedia`, `getDisplayMedia`, feature-detected). Returns `camera`, `screen`, `supported`, `error`, `startCamera`, `startScreen`, `stopCamera`, `stopScreen`, `stopAll`, `controller`; stops every track on unmount. `createLocalMedia({ mediaDevices? })` is the same without React. Types `LocalMedia`, `LocalMediaSnapshot`, `CreateLocalMediaOptions`, `UseLocalMediaResult`.
- `followLevels({ levels, source, onLevel })`: reads one level in animation frames, eased, with no React render; returns the stop function. `createLevels()` makes a `VoiceLevels` a transport can feed with `set`. `SILENT_LEVELS`, `LevelSource`, `FollowLevelsOptions`.
- `summariseCall(snapshot, now?)`: the `VoiceCallSummary` (`durationMs`, settled `transcript`, `startedAt`, `endedAt`) for a `CallCard`. `formatCallDuration(ms)`: `4:07`.

## Tokens

- `ChatKitTokens`, `ChatKitColorTokens`, `ChatKitSharedTokens`, `ChatKitTokenOverrides`: the colour roles (accent, text, surface, border, userBubble, codeSurface, info, success, warning, error ...) and shared values (radius, fonts, code themes).
- `CHAT_KIT_COLOR_TOKEN_NAMES`, `CHAT_KIT_SHARED_TOKEN_NAMES`: the token names.
- `applyChatKitOverrides(base, overrides)`: merges overrides; a scheme-specific value beats a top-level one.
- `chatKitVariableName("userBubbleText")`: `--nck-user-bubble-text`.
- `DEFAULT_CODE_THEME_LIGHT`, `DEFAULT_CODE_THEME_DARK`, `DEFAULT_MONO_FONT_FAMILY`: defaults.

## Approvals

- `APPROVAL_INTERRUPT_KIND`: `"tool_approval"`. `APPROVE_ANSWER`, `EDIT_ANSWER`, `DENY_ANSWER`: the three answers. `approvalAnswerLabel(answer)`: the words the transcript shows.
- `ApprovalInterrupt`, `ApprovalField`, `ApprovalFieldType`: an approval request and its form fields.
- `parseApprovalValues(fields, values)` and `ParsedApprovalValues`: validates the form values.
- `fieldLabel`, `humanizeKey`: display text for a field and a wire key.
- `REQUIRED_FIELD_ERROR`, `NUMBER_FIELD_ERROR`, `BOOLEAN_TRUE`, `BOOLEAN_FALSE`: form constants.

## Markdown and maths

- `hasMathDelimiter`, `normalizeMathDelimiters`, `joinMathBlocks`: prepare streamed text for maths.
- `loadMathPlugins`, `useMathPlugins(enabled)`, `resetMathPluginsForTests`, `MathPlugins`: load remark-math, rehype-katex and the KaTeX stylesheet on demand.

## Copy constants

- `TURN_ACTION_COPY`, `FEEDBACK_COPY`, `EDIT_FORM_COPY`, `DELETE_CONFIRM_COPY`, `MESSAGE_NOTE_COPY`, `REASONING_TRIGGER_COPY`, `TURN_TIMELINE_COPY`, `GENERIC_THOUGHT_TITLE`: the user-facing strings of the turn controls.

# MUI entry: `@hiro/niru-chat-kit/mui`

## Theme

- `ChatKitProvider`: supplies tokens and writes `--nck-*` CSS variables. Props: `tokens` (overrides; top-level colours apply to both schemes, `light` and `dark` set one). Example: `<ChatKitProvider tokens={{ accent: "#0e7c66", radius: 10 }}>{children}</ChatKitProvider>`
- `useChatKitTokens()`: the resolved tokens. `useChatKitStyles()`: tokens plus `scheme((colors, all) => sx)` for per-scheme styles.
- `createChatKitTokens(theme, overrides)`: tokens for an MUI theme.
- `setChatKitDefaultOverrides`, `getChatKitDefaultOverrides`, `mergeChatKitOverrides`: app-wide default overrides.
- `colorVariables`, `blend`, `readableOn`, `getContrastRatio`, `AA_CONTRAST`: colour helpers.
- `ChatLook`, `ChatLookProvider`, `useChatLook`: optional looks (`stepsCard`), all off by default.

## Whole chat

- `FullChat`: a whole chat on one `useChatStream` result. Props: `stream`, `agent`, `greeting`, `starters`, `placeholder`, `history`, `attachments`, `onAttach`, `columnMaxWidth`, `emptyState`, `header` (a node above the conversation), `highlightMessageId`, `disabled`, `errorAction`, `look`, `onStartCall` (call button next to Send), `callLabel`, `callDisabled`, `voicePlacement` (as on `Composer`), `aboveComposer` (a node directly above the composer or interrupt card, for example a `CallStrip`), `decideAnswer` (adds a "Let the agent decide" link to a question card that answers with this phrase), `decideLabel`, `questionLabels`. A pending question (any interrupt that is not an approval) shows as a `QuestionCard` in the thread, the composer stays and answers it, and an answered question folds into one line. Example: `<FullChat stream={stream} agent={{ name: "Niru", initial: "N" }} starters={["What can you do?"]} />` It also passes the composer's opt-in extras straight through: `addMenu`, `chips`, `pastedTexts`, `onPasteLongText`, `onRemovePastedText`, `onShowPastedText`, `longPasteThreshold`, `mentions`, `onMention`, `mentionsLabel`, `mentionsEmptyText`, `mentionsLoading`, `approvalMode`, `endLeading`, `extrasLabels` (see `Composer`).
- `FullChatProps`, `FullChatStream`: its props and the slice of the hook it reads.
- `Conversation`: the auto-following `role="log"` transcript. Props: `messages`, `typing`, `turnActions`, `onStop`, `stopInTranscript` (default `true`; `false` keeps "Thinking" without its Stop link, for an app whose composer shows Stop through `running`), `agentAvatar`, `liveAvatar`, `emptyState`, `footer`, `columnMaxWidth`, `renderMessage`, `renderExtras`, `highlightMessageId` (scrolls that turn into view inside the chat and tints it for about 2.5 seconds; a still outline under reduced motion; turns carry `data-message-id`), `question` (`{ interrupt, onAnswer, onOther?, decideAnswer?, decideLabel?, pending?, labels? }`: a pending question drawn as a card after the last turn), `foldAnswers` (a user turn with `answersQuestion` draws as one line), `onChangeAnswer`. Example: `<Conversation messages={messages} typing={status === "connecting"} turnActions={turnActions} />`
- `ConversationProps`, `ConversationTurn`, `ConversationTurnProps`: one memoised turn (user bubble, or avatar with timeline, answer, files, notes and actions).
- `columnPadding(maxWidth)`: side padding that centres content in a column.
- `TypingDots`: the typing dots alone.
- `ChatEmptyState`: avatar, greeting and tappable starter chips. Props: `greeting`, `suggestions`, `onSuggestion`, `agentInitial`, `avatar`.

## History sidebar

- `ChatHistorySidebar`: the conversation list with identity, New chat and rows. Props: `items`, `activeId`, `onSelect`, `onNew`, `identity`, `hasMore`, `loading`, `onLoadMore`, `collapseBelow`, plus optional `searchable` (search box filtering title and preview), `grouped` (Today, Yesterday, Previous 7 days, Previous 30 days, Older by the item's `at`), `onRename(id, title)` and `onDelete(id)` (a per-row menu; delete asks first), `labels` (override any text), `now` (for tests), `onPin(id, pinned)` (Pin / Unpin in the row menu; items with `pinned: true` go in a Pinned group first), `saved` (a `SavedItem[]`; adds Chats and Saved tabs, newest first), `onOpenSaved(item)`, `onUnsave(item)`, `tab` and `onTabChange` (controlled tab; uncontrolled by default) and `highlightId` (flashes that Chats row when it changes). Example: `<ChatHistorySidebar items={rows} activeId={id} onSelect={open} onNew={create} searchable grouped onRename={rename} onDelete={remove} />`
- `ChatHistorySidebarProps`, `ChatHistoryItem` (`id`, `title?`, `preview?`, `at?`, `pinned?`), `ChatHistoryTab` (`"chats" | "saved"`), `ChatHistoryIdentity`, `ChatHistoryLabels`, `DEFAULT_HISTORY_LABELS`: types and default texts.
- `SavedItem` (`id`, `kind: "conversation" | "message"`, `conversationId`, `messageId?`, `title`, `text?`, `at`), `SavedKind`: what the Saved tab lists. Core helpers: `splitPinned`, `filterSaved`, `sortSavedNewestFirst`. `SavedList` draws the rows of the Saved tab.
- `ConversationHeader`: a compact bar above a chat. Props: `title`, `pinned`, `onPinChange(next)`, `saved`, `onSaveChange(next)` (bookmark, `aria-pressed`, tooltip "Save chat" / "Saved"), `actions`, `labels`. Pass it to `FullChat` as `header`. Example: `<ConversationHeader title="Refunds" saved={saved} onSaveChange={setSaved} />`. Types: `ConversationHeaderProps`, `ConversationHeaderLabels`, `DEFAULT_HEADER_LABELS`.

## Composer

- `Composer`: the prompt box. Required: `value`, `onChange`, `onSubmit`. Optional: `onStop`, `busy`, `running` (a turn runs while the box still takes text: Send becomes Stop while the box is empty and comes back when the person types, so they can steer; needs `onStop`), `disabled`, `placeholder`, `settings`, `attachments`, `onAttach`, `onRemoveAttachment`, `accept`, `suggestions`, `trailing`, `endActions`, `inputRef`, plus `voice` (`true`: mic toggle that dictates into the box where the browser supports speech recognition; or `ComposerVoiceOptions`: `transcribe`, `microphoneId`, `maxDurationMs`, `microphones` (`{ deviceId, label }[]`, for example from `useMicrophones()`) with `onSelectMicrophone(deviceId)` (with both, and at least one microphone, a "Choose microphone" caret joins the mic: a menu of radio items with `microphoneId` checked; disabled while recording or transcribing; on a narrow composer with `voicePlacement="end"` the list is in More), `disabledReason` (mic shown disabled with this as tooltip and description) and `labels` (`ComposerVoiceLabels`, defaults `DEFAULT_COMPOSER_VOICE_LABELS`) to record, show the time and a level, and hand the audio to the app; Escape or the mic stops and transcribes, Cancel discards, the draft is never changed on failure; `FullChat` takes the same `voice`), `voiceLang`, `voicePlacement` (`"start"`, default, or `"end"`: the mic immediately left of Send, drawn like the call button, with the call button before it; on a narrow composer the row is then attach, More, call, mic, Send), `toggles` (on/off chips with `aria-pressed`) and `moreActions` (menu items behind a "More" button), `narrowMoreItems` (menu items, or `({ closeMenu }) => items`, shown in More instead of `trailing` when the composer is narrower than 460 px; there the row is attach, More, call, Send, and voice input is a More item), `endLeading` (content at the right end of the row, just before call, voice and Send; follows `trailing` into More when `narrowMoreItems` is given and the box is narrow), `moreLabel`, `onStartCall` (round call button before Send), `callLabel` (default "Start a call"), `callDisabled`, `answering` (`{ question }`: shows an "Answering: ..." chip and the placeholder "Type your answer"), `answeringLabel`, `answeringPlaceholder`, and slash commands: `commands` (`SlashCommand[]`; typing `/` first in the box opens a list above it, typing filters, ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Home/End move, Enter or Tab pick, Escape closes until the text changes; Enter sends as usual when nothing matches), `onCommand(command)` (after the box is updated; a command without `insert` is an action), `commandsLabel` (default "Commands"), `onManageCommands` (adds a last row that calls it and closes the list), `manageCommandsLabel` (default "Edit commands"), `commandsEmptyText` (default "No matching commands"); `FullChat` takes the same props. Opt-in extras, each shown only when its prop is given (`FullChat` takes the same): `addMenu` (`{ label?, sections: ComposerAddSection[] }`: a round plus button replaces the paperclip and opens an "Add" panel above the box; first row is the upload action when `onAttach` is given and the box is enabled; section `{ id, title?, items, searchable?, searchPlaceholder?, emptyText?, loading? }`; item `ComposerAddItem` `{ id, label, description?, icon?, onSelect, disabled?, disabledReason?, checked?, keepOpen? }`, `checked` defined makes it a `menuitemcheckbox`), `chips` (`ComposerChip[]`: `{ id, label, icon?, onRemove?, removeLabel?, onClick?, tone?: "default" | "accent" | "warning" }`, in the row after the plus, above the row when narrow), long pasted text (`onPasteLongText(text)` takes a long plain-text paste out of the box, `longPasteThreshold` `{ characters?: 2000, lines?: 40 }`, `pastedTexts` `ComposerPastedText[]` `{ id, text, title? }` drawn as chips with size, a "Show in text field" link `onShowPastedText(id)` and remove `onRemovePastedText(id)`; the app holds the text), `mentions` (`ComposerMention[]` `{ id, label, description?, icon?, group?, keywords? }`: `@` at the start or after whitespace opens a list; picking writes `@Label ` and calls `onMention(item)`; `mentionsLabel`, `mentionsEmptyText`, `mentionsLoading`), `approvalMode` (`ComposerApprovalMode`: `{ value, options: { value, label, description?, icon?, tone?: "default" | "warning" }[], onChange, heading?, learnMore?: { label, onClick }, disabled?, disabledReason?, buttonLabel?, iconOnly? }`, a quiet button that opens a `menuitemradio` menu; in More when narrow) and `extrasLabels` (`Partial<ComposerExtrasLabels>`, defaults `DEFAULT_COMPOSER_EXTRAS_LABELS`). Core helpers: `mentionQuery(value, caret)`, `applyMention(value, range, item)` (`{ value, caret }`), `matchMentions(items, query)`, `mentionsIn(value, items)`, `isLongPaste(text, threshold?)`, `pastedTextTitle(text)`. Example: `<Composer value={draft} onChange={setDraft} onSubmit={send} voice toggles={[{ id: "web", label: "Search the web", icon: <PublicIcon />, active: web, onToggle: () => setWeb(!web) }]} />`
- `ComposerProps`, `ComposerAttachment` (`id`, `name`, `kind?`, `previewUrl?`), `ComposerToggle` (`id`, `label`, `icon`, `active`, `onToggle`, `disabled?`, `iconOnly?`: a round icon button instead of a labelled chip): types.
- `ComposerPills`, `SuggestionPills`, `FOLLOW_UPS_LABEL`: follow-up or starter pills above the box.
- `ComposerSuggestionsList`, `useComposerSuggestions`, `ComposerSuggestionsController`, `filterSuggestions`: autocomplete candidates above the field.
- `SlashCommandMenu`, `useSlashCommands`, `SlashCommandsController`, `SlashCommandMenuProps`: the slash-command list above the field and the state behind it. `Composer` wires them when `commands` is passed. Core: `SlashCommand` (`id`, `name`, `description?`, `keywords?`, `group?`, `insert?`, `disabled?`), `SlashQuery`, `slashQuery(text, caret)` (the `/query` being typed, only when the slash is the first non-space character and the caret is inside that first token), `matchSlashCommands(commands, query)` (prefix, then name contains, then keyword or description; stable) and `applySlashCommand(text, range, command)` (`{ text, caret }`). Example: `<Composer value={draft} onChange={setDraft} onSubmit={send} commands={[{ id: "sum", name: "summarize", insert: "Summarize this: " }, { id: "clear", name: "clear" }]} onCommand={(c) => c.id === "clear" && track(c)} onManageCommands={openEditor} />`
- `PromptInput`: compound input surface (`PromptInput.Textarea`, `.Actions`, `.Action`). Props: `value`, `onValueChange`, `onSubmit`, `isLoading`, `disabled`, `maxRows`. `PromptInputTextarea`, `PromptInputActions`, `PromptInputAction` and `usePromptInput()` are the parts and context; `PromptInputSlotProps`, `PromptInputTextareaSlotProps`, `PromptInputActionsSlotProps`, `PromptInputActionSlotProps` type their slots.
- `PromptSuggestion`: one suggestion chip or row. Props: `children`, `onSelect`, `highlight`, `variant`. `PromptSuggestionSlotProps`.
- `FileUpload`: drop and pick files (`FileUpload.Trigger`, `.Content`). Props: `onFilesAdded`, `accept`, `multiple`, `scope`. `FileUploadTrigger`, `FileUploadContent`, `FileUploadProps`, `FileUploadTriggerProps`, `FileUploadScope`, `FileUploadSlotProps`.
- `DataAttributes`: extra `data-*` attributes accepted by `rootProps`.

## A turn

- `TurnActions`: the controls under a settled turn: copy, regenerate, edit, version arrows, rating and, when `actions.onDelete` is given, Delete behind a confirm, and when `actions.onSave` is given, a Save bookmark after Copy. Props: `message`, `actions` (a `ChatTurnActions`), `onStartEdit`. Example: `<TurnActions message={m} actions={{ disabled: false, onDelete: remove }} onStartEdit={edit} />`
- `TurnCopyButton`: copies a reply's markdown and says "Copied".
- `TurnTimeline`: the activity timeline of a turn ("Worked for 7s"). `TurnSteps`, `summarizeTurnSteps`, `TurnStepsSummary`: a turn's steps inside `Reasoning`.
- `MessageNotes`: notes on how an answer ended (stopped, not grounded).
- `MessageEditForm`: a user turn opened for editing; Save sends a new branch. Props: `initialText`, `disabled`, `onSave`, `onCancel`.
- `SourceList`: the Sources row under a reply, from `citations`.
- `FileChip`, `FileChipList`, `FileDownloader`: generated files with an optional download.
- `MessageMedia` (core type `MediaItem`): images, videos and sounds under an assistant reply. Props: `items`, `onOpen(item)` (replaces the lightbox), `onDownload(item)`, `onRetry(item)`, `labels` (`MessageMediaLabels`, defaults `DEFAULT_MESSAGE_MEDIA_LABELS`), `maxColumns` (default 2), `maxHeight` (default 360). `MediaItem` is `{ id, kind: "image" | "video" | "audio", src: string | null, status: "loading" | "ready" | "failed", alt?, title?, mime?, width?, height?, poster?, durationSeconds?, filename? }`. `Conversation`, `ConversationTurn` and `FullChat` take `renderMedia(message) => MediaItem[] | undefined` and `mediaProps` (the props above without `items`). Example: `<Conversation messages={m} renderMedia={(msg) => media[msg.id]} mediaProps={{ onDownload }} />`
- `AgentAvatar`: an agent's avatar (uploaded image or preset). `AVATAR_PRESETS`, `presetById`, `AgentAvatarProps`, `AgentAvatarValue`, `AvatarPreset`, `AvatarAccessory`.

## Interrupts

- `InterruptPrompt`: the pause a run waits on: a question or an approval. Props: `interrupt`, `onAnswer`, `pending`.
- `QuestionCard`: an agent's question as a card in the thread. Props: `question`, `options` (numbered rows, keys 1 to 9 pick them), `onAnswer`, `onOther` (adds a "Something else" row), `decideAnswer` and `decideLabel` ("Let the agent decide"), `answered` (folds into one line), `onChange` (a Change link), `showQuestion` (false when the reply already ends with it), `pending`, `keyboard`, `labels`. Core adds `isQuestionInterrupt`, `replyEndsWithQuestion` and `ChatMessage.answersQuestion`.
- `ApprovalCard`: waiting calls, the resume form and Approve, Edit, Deny. Props: `interrupt`, `onAnswer`, `pending`, `disabledAnswers`.
- `ApprovalFormFields`: the controls for one resume form. `InterruptEditForm`, `EditableAction`: edit a waiting call before approving.

## Call mode

- `CallStage`: the full-screen call in the Gemini Live layout. Props: `session`, `user` (`name`, `avatar`), `agent` (`name`, `avatar` as the mark), `menu` (top-left slot), `labels` (any key of `CallLabels`; `{name}` is the person, `{agent}` the agent), `visual` (`pill` default or `orb`), `colors`, `onMinimise` (Escape and a button), `onClose`, `onCallAgain`, `autoFocus`, `children` (your own layout). Space toggles mute, End needs no confirm. Parts: `CallStage.Header`, `.Status`, `.Captions`, `.Preview`, `.Controls`, exported flat as `CallStageHeader`, `CallStageStatus`, `CallStageCaptions`, `CallStagePreview`, `CallStageControls` with `CallStageProps`, `CallStageHeaderProps`, `CallStageStatusProps`, `CallStageCaptionsProps`, `CallStageControlsProps`. `statusKeyOf(snapshot)` names the label of a state. Example: `<CallStage session={session} user={{ name: "Kio" }} onMinimise={minimise} />`
- `VoiceLevelPill`: the default visual, a wide dark pill whose bottom glow rises and ripples with a level. Props: `levels`, `source` (`you`, `agent`, `none`), `height`, `still`. `VoiceLevelPillProps`.
- `CallOrb`: Niru's orb as the second visual (WebGL shader, CSS circle fallback). Props: `state` (`OrbState`), `levels`, `size`, `label`, `still`. `CallOrbProps`, `orbStateOf(snapshot)`, `OrbState`, `orbColorsOf(colors)`, `DEFAULT_ORB_SIZE`.
- `CallControlButton`: one round dark control. Props: `label`, `icon`, `onClick`, `active`, `danger`, `disabled`, `size`. `CallControlButtonProps`.
- `CallStrip`: the minimised call. Props: `session`, `agentName`, `userName`, `labels`, `colors`, `onExpand` (the main button, labelled `labels.openCall`, "Open call"), `microphones`, `microphoneId`, `onSelectMicrophone` (a "Choose microphone" menu next to Mute), `activity` (wins over `snapshot.activity`; replaces the status text while thinking or speaking, one line with an ellipsis and the full text as a tooltip), `quietAfterMs` (default 8000; with no activity the thinking status becomes "Still working on it"). `CallStripProps`. `CallStage` takes `activity` and `quietAfterMs` too and draws the sentence as a second line under the status inside the call's one polite live region; it goes away when the call returns to listening, and it does not animate under reduced motion. New call label `stillWorking`. `useCallActivity`, `DEFAULT_QUIET_AFTER_MS`, `CallActivity`. `CallStage` takes the same three microphone props and shows the same menu next to its microphone button; both fall back to `snapshot.microphones`, `snapshot.microphoneId` and `session.selectMicrophone` (all optional on `VoiceSnapshot` and `VoiceSession`, type `VoiceMicrophone { deviceId, label }`). Nothing is drawn when nothing can select.
- `CallCard`: the finished call in the conversation with a transcript toggle. Props: `summary`, `agentName`, `userName`, `labels`, `defaultOpen`, `onCallAgain`. `CallCardProps`.
- `CallProblemScreen`: microphone blocked, connection lost, ended. Props: `kind`. `CallProblemKind`, `CallProblemScreenProps`, `problemScreenOf(snapshot)`.
- `useCallColors(overrides?)`, `CallColors`, `CallColorOverrides`: the call colours, derived from the dark-scheme tokens. `DEFAULT_CALL_LABELS`, `CallLabels`, `CallLabelKey`: every word. `CallPerson`, `CallVisual`: types. `useReducedMotion()`: `prefers-reduced-motion`, kept current.

## Primitives

- `Message`: a chat row (`Message.Avatar`, `.Content`, `.Actions`, `.Action`). Props: `from`. `MessageAvatar`, `MessageContent`, `MessageActions`, `MessageAction`, `MessageFrom`, `MESSAGE_AVATAR_SIZE`, `MESSAGE_ROW_GAP`, `MESSAGE_CONTENT_OFFSET`.
- `ChatContainer`: auto-following scrollable log (`ChatContainer.Root`, `.Content`, `.ScrollAnchor`). `ChatContainerRoot`, `ChatContainerContent`, `ChatContainerScrollAnchor`, `ChatContainerRootProps`, `useChatContainer()`.
- `ScrollButton`: jump to the latest. Props: `visible`, `onClick`. `ScrollButtonSlotProps`.
- `Markdown` (alias `ChatMarkdown`): GFM markdown with optional maths, no raw HTML. `MarkdownBlock` is one memoised block; `markdownStyles(colors, tokens)` are its styles.
- `CodeBlock`: Shiki-highlighted code with a copy button. Props: `code`, `language`. Parts: `CodeBlockCode`, `CodeBlockGroup`, `CodeBlockCopyButton`. `CodeBlockProps`, `CodeThemes`. `highlightCode(code, language, themes)` highlights with a dynamic shiki import.
- `Loader`, `TextShimmer`, `ThinkingBar`: waiting indicators. `Loader` props `variant`, `size`, `text`; `LoaderVariant`, `LoaderSize`; `TextShimmerProps`; `ThinkingBar` props `text`, `onStop`; `ThinkingBarSlotProps`.
- `Reasoning`: collapsible model thinking (`Reasoning.Trigger`, `.Content`). Props: `isStreaming`, `open`, `onOpenChange`. `ReasoningTrigger`, `ReasoningContent`, `ReasoningTriggerSlotProps`, `ReasoningContentSlotProps`, `useReasoning()`.
- `Steps`: a step list (`Steps.Trigger`, `.Content`, `.Item`, `.Bar`). `StepsTrigger`, `StepsContent`, `StepsItem`, `StepsBar`, `StepsSlotProps`, `StepsTriggerSlotProps`, `StepsContentSlotProps`, `StepsItemSlotProps`, `useSteps()`.
- `ChainOfThought`: step-by-step reasoning (`.Step`, `.Trigger`, `.Content`, `.Item`). `ChainOfThoughtStep`, `ChainOfThoughtTrigger`, `ChainOfThoughtContent`, `ChainOfThoughtItem`, with the slot types `ChainOfThoughtSlotProps`, `ChainOfThoughtStepSlotProps`, `ChainOfThoughtTriggerSlotProps`, `ChainOfThoughtContentSlotProps` and `ChainOfThoughtItemSlotProps`, and `useChainOfThought()`, `useChainOfThoughtStep()`.
- `Tool` (alias `ToolCard`): one tool call as an expandable card. Props: `step` (a `WorkingStep`), `defaultOpen`, `formatName`, `slotProps`, plus optional `state` (the prompt-kit states `input-streaming`, `input-available`, `output-available`, `output-error`, read as running, running, done, failed), `input` and `output` (any value: a string shows as text, anything else as pretty JSON coloured from the tokens; shown in the expanded card, collapsed by default; nothing renders when both are absent). Example: `<Tool step={step} state="output-available" input={{ query: "pricing" }} output="3 results" />`
- `ToolState`, `ToolSlotProps`, `cardToolName(name)`: types and the prefix-free tool name.
- `ToolArgsList`, `toolArgEntries`, `ToolActionArgs`, `ToolArgEntry`: a call's arguments as `key: value` rows.
- `Source`: a citation chip and card (`Source.Trigger`, `.Content`). Props: `href`. `SourceTrigger`, `SourceContent`, `SourceSlotProps`, `SourceTriggerSlotProps`, `SourceContentSlotProps`, `useSource()`, `faviconHost(href)`.
- `ResponseStream`: text revealed as it streams. Props: `text`, `mode` (`plain` or `fade`).
- `SystemMessage`: a notice. Props: `severity`, `children`, `action`. `SystemMessageSlotProps`.
- `FeedbackBar`: thumbs up and down. Props: `value`, `onRate`, `disabled`. `FeedbackBarSlotProps`.
- `Image` (alias `ChatImage`): a safe image with skeleton and error fallback. Props: `src`, or `base64` / `uint8Array` with `mediaType` (object URLs are revoked on change and unmount; a `mediaType` that is not `image/*` is refused), `alt`. `ImageProps`. Example: `<Image uint8Array={bytes} mediaType="image/png" alt="chart" />`
- `JSXPreview`: renders agent-written markup under an allowlist; off unless `components` is passed. Props: `jsx`, `components`, `isStreaming`. `JSXPreviewProps`, `parseJsx`, `parseStyle`, `SAFE_HTML_TAGS`. Do not enable it on a public surface.
